description:
Edit images with Express without leaving #AdobeInDesign! This is perfect for quick tweaks—like removing a background, swapping to B&W, adding an effect, and more.

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to:
• Remove backgrounds and convert images to B&W without leaving InDesign
• Apply duotone and color effects using Express from within your layout
• Replace the original file or save a new copy — all in one step

Great for editorial designers, layout artists, and anyone finishing a document on deadline.

Ready to keep your flow and still edit your images? Comment below and save this tutorial for your next design.
